# Backlog overview

**Owner:** Scrum Master

Stories live in `docs/todo/<epic>/<feature>/<id>-<slug>.md`; bug stories in `docs/todo/bugs/`; completed stories move, flat, to `docs/done/`. Each epic folder has a `README.md` listing its features and stories in priority order. Story IDs are one sequence across all epics.
